name: Z2 容器类型元组
code:
print(isinstance([1], (list, dict)))
print(isinstance({1: 2}, (list, dict)))
print(isinstance((1,), (list, tuple)))
print(isinstance({1}, (list, set)))

name: Z3 用户异常层次
code:
class Base(Exception):
    pass
class Sub(Base):
    pass
print(issubclass(Sub, Base))
print(issubclass(Base, Sub))
print(issubclass(Sub, Exception))
print(issubclass(ValueError, Exception))

name: Z4 isinstance 在表达式里
code:
xs = [1, 'a', 2.5]
n = 0
for v in xs:
    if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
        n = n + 1
print(n)
print(isinstance(xs, (list, tuple)) and True)
